title: Status hidden in a pile of flags
purpose: Finds features whose real status is spread across a pile of yes/no flags, so combinations that should be impossible can happen.
you_get: A list of states and transitions per feature, each with file:line, plus one reachable invalid combination shown concretely.

title: Meaning drift across the stack
needs: Repository access and read-only access to the database layout.
purpose: Shows where one word (a task, a fund, a run) means slightly different things in different parts of the app.
you_get: One table per concept: layer, type or column, validation rule, file:line. Mismatches marked.

title: Layers that don't earn their keep
purpose: Finds extra layers of code you could delete so the code, and the agents reading it, get simpler.
you_get: For each candidate: callers count, what deleting it would move where (the deletion test), and what tests would change.
cluster: Code is hard to change: alternative

title: Two systems that disagree
purpose: Finds data kept in two places (a saved copy and a table, the browser and the server) that can quietly disagree.
you_get: Pairs of stores with the field, who writes each, how they sync, and a sequence of events that makes them diverge.
cluster: The same fact stored twice: primary

title: Old design choices that now cost you
purpose: Separates old design choices that now cost real time or bugs from ones that are only out of fashion.
you_get: Each decision with the original reason, the current cost (incidents, workarounds, slow paths) and evidence for that cost.

title: Code that relies on lucky timing
changes: Adds a test that shows it
needs: Repository; a way to run the code locally to reproduce the problem.
purpose: Finds code that only works because things usually happen in the right order.
you_get: The assumed order, what can reorder it (retry, webhook, slow network), and a reproduction for the worst case.

title: Timers and connections nobody closes
needs: Repository access; memory snapshots help confirm.
purpose: Finds timers, listeners and connections that nobody clearly owns or shuts off.

cluster: Resources that are never released: alternative

title: Screens that fight how people work
needs: Repository; the app running locally with test accounts for the browser checks.
purpose: Finds when confusing screens are a symptom of how the product is organised rather than a list of separate bugs.

cluster: Navigation, Back button and shared links: alternative

title: Slowest journeys, end to end
needs: Browser developer tools or Playwright recordings, server logs or timing data, and the database's query plan (EXPLAIN).
purpose: Shows where the seconds go on the paths people actually use.
you_get: A timed trace per journey (browser network panel, server timing, query time) with each step's share of the total.
cluster: The app is slow: primary

title: Steps that wait for no reason
needs: Repository; a timing script to measure the result afterward.
purpose: Finds steps that wait for each other to finish when they could run at the same time.

cluster: The app is slow: alternative

cluster: The app is slow: alternative

title: Work repeated for nothing

title: Memory that keeps growing

title: One slow step that blocks the rest

title: Safe to run twice?

title: Updates that overwrite each other
changes: Adds a test that shows it
needs: Repository; a local or branch-copy database to reproduce the problem.
purpose: Finds updates that overwrite newer data because two things wrote at once.

title: Half-finished failures
changes: Adds a test that shows it

purpose: Finds what is left behind when something fails halfway.

title: Lost place: Back, refresh and shared links

changes: Adds a test that shows it

purpose: Finds security checks that let people in when something goes wrong.

changes: Adds a test that shows it

purpose: Lists every way 'merged' can fail to mean 'live'.

title: Check time that catches nothing
needs: GitHub Actions run history via gh.
purpose: Finds paid automated-check minutes spent on checks that never catch anything.

title: Dashboard and repo out of sync
needs: Vercel and database dashboards or MCP tools, read-only.
purpose: Finds where the hosting dashboard and the repo disagree.
you_get: Each setting declared in the repo next to its live value, with the source of each.
cluster: Settings that differ by environment: alternative
audit_note: Tools line assumes Vercel.

title: Packages nobody uses, or that work by luck
needs: Repository; a package checker such as knip or depcheck if already present.
purpose: Finds packages nobody uses and packages that work only by accident.
you_get: Each package with every import site (including config files and scripts) and the bundle or install cost.

title: Old runtimes and when support ends
needs: A terminal on your computer; vendor release pages.
purpose: Finds old browser runtimes on your computer and which are safe to remove, before a cleanup breaks an app that needs them.
you_get: Each runtime with version, owner app, support status from the vendor, size, and a rollback path.
audit_note: Audits the user's computer, not the repo; rarely the job people come for.

title: Missing vs zero vs stale
purpose: Finds where 'we don't know' turns into 0 and then into a wrong total.
you_get: Each field with how each absence state is stored, how calculations treat it, and how it displays.

title: Where did this number come from?
needs: Repository, read-only database, and the source documents the numbers come from.
purpose: Checks that every number on screen can be traced back to a source document.
you_get: For each metric: raw inputs, formula with file:line, and an independent recomputation for one real record.
cluster: Are the numbers right?: alternative

title: Old records, new meanings
needs: Read-only database access, history of database changes.
purpose: Finds old records that read differently once today's rules are applied to them.
you_get: Each classification with when it changed, which records predate it, and how the app reads them now.
cluster: History that changes meaning: alternative

title: Imports that fail quietly
purpose: Finds rows that go missing or land on the wrong record during import, with no error.
you_get: Each ingestion step with its matching key, conflict rule and what it logs, plus counts in versus counts stored.
cluster: Imports that lose or merge records: primary

title: Links between records worth adding
purpose: Finds links between records worth adding, and ones the evidence does not support.
you_get: Each relationship with its source evidence, current coverage, and gaps.

title: Code health, with proof
purpose: A general health check of the code that refuses findings without evidence.
you_get: A ranked list of under fifteen issues, each with file:line or a command, confidence and impact.
audit_note: A general health check; narrower investigations usually fit better.

title: Out-of-date agent instructions
purpose: Finds instructions that send agents to files and patterns that no longer exist.
you_get: Each stale line with the file it lives in and the current fact it contradicts.
cluster: Out-of-date agent instructions: primary

title: Database changes during a deploy
needs: Repository, migrations folder, previous release tag.
purpose: Checks that each database change works with the old code that is still live while a release finishes.
you_get: Each recent migration checked against the previous release's queries, with any break shown.
cluster: Ship a database change: alternative

title: Hidden data anyone can read
needs: Browser network panel or curl against a local server.
purpose: Finds data sent to the browser that the screen hides but anyone can read.
you_get: Each payload with the fields sent, the fields used, and any field that should never leave the server.

title: When an outside service goes down
needs: Repository; a local run with outside services made to fail on purpose.
purpose: Asks what happens to the app when an outside API, an AI provider or a service that sends it updates goes down.
you_get: Each dependency with its timeout, retry policy, what is held open while waiting, and the user-visible result.

title: Rounding and unit mix-ups
needs: Repository and read-only access to the database layout.
purpose: Finds money and percentage values that change scale or lose precision along the way.
you_get: Each value's unit at every hop, with any hop where the unit or rounding changes.
cluster: Units and rounding: primary

title: Screens showing a change that was refused
changes: Adds a test that shows it
needs: In-app browser or Playwright set to block or alter requests.
purpose: Finds screens that show a change right away and keep showing it after the server refused it.
you_get: Each optimistic flow with a forced rejection and a screenshot or test of what the screen then shows.

title: Motion nobody chose
purpose: Shows whether the app's motion follows a system or was typed one animation at a time.
you_get: A table of distinct durations and curves with counts, each outlier with file:line, and a mapping from existing values to a proposed set of about four durations and three curves.
cluster: Motion that stutters or feels inconsistent: alternative

title: Animations that cost frames
needs: Repository; the app running locally and a browser with performance tooling (DevTools or Playwright).
purpose: Finds the animations that stutter on slower phones and laptops, and what each one costs.
you_get: Each candidate with file:line and the property involved; for the worst three, a throttled recording with the layout count and the frames over budget, taken before any change.
cluster: Motion that stutters or feels inconsistent: alternative

title: Motion with no off switch
needs: Repository; a browser that can emulate prefers-reduced-motion.
purpose: Finds motion that can make people dizzy or lock them out, and content that disappears when animation is turned off.
you_get: A list of moving animations with file:line and whether each has a reduced version; a browser run with reduced motion emulated showing what still moves; the WCAG criterion behind each gap (2.2.2, 2.3.1, 2.3.3, 2.5.1 or 2.5.7).

title: Animations that restart, block or never finish
changes: Adds a test that shows it
needs: Repository; the app running locally with a browser to trigger interactions quickly.
purpose: Finds motion that works in a demo and breaks under fast, real use.
you_get: Each case with file:line, the sequence of inputs that triggers it, and what the user sees: a restart, a jump, an ignored click or a missing exit.

title: Motion with no job
purpose: Produces a list of animations to delete or shorten, which is usually the cheapest way to make an app feel faster.
you_get: One row per animation: where it is (file:line), how often a person meets it in a day, the job it does or "none", and remove, shorten or keep.

title: State changes with no feedback
purpose: Finds the few places where a small animation would remove real confusion.
you_get: Each moment with its flow, the component (file:line), what the user is left guessing, and a one-line spec for the motion.
